label: GitHub Discussion
description: A discussion in a repository the GitHub connector syncs, whose title, body and open or closed state travel both ways. Its category, answer and lock are read from GitHub.

github_id.description: The discussion's GitHub node id: set from GitHub for a discussion read from it, and from GitHub's answer for a row created in Marfa and sent there. A row without one has not been sent to GitHub.

number.description: The discussion's number in its repository.

repository.description: The repository's full name, as owner/name.

private.description: Whether the repository this row is in is private on GitHub, as of the last read: a row marked private holds what is not public, and its contents are not to be copied into a public place.

author.description: The GitHub login that started the discussion.

category.description: The name of the discussion's category. Set it when creating a discussion in Marfa: it must name one of the repository's categories. GitHub's answer is read back afterwards, and a later change in Marfa is not carried.

status.description: Whether the discussion is open or closed on GitHub. Setting it to closed closes the discussion on GitHub, and setting it to open reopens it.

state_reason.description: Why GitHub says the discussion is closed or was reopened: resolved, outdated, duplicate or reopened. Set it with status closed to close for that reason; a discussion closed without one is closed as resolved.

answered.description: Whether the discussion has an answer chosen on GitHub.

locked.description: Whether the discussion is locked on GitHub.

github_updated_at.description: When GitHub last changed the discussion. A new comment may not move it.
